rows.grounds: conditional particle introducing a hypothetical case
compound expressing the state of being inseparable from heat
illustrative instance cited in the argument
ablative source indicating the locus of burning used as example

items.question: Can the burning substrate serve as a valid example when heat is inseparable?
premises: Heat is treated as inseparable from fire.
An example is proposed from the burning substrate.
A valid example requires a distinguishable basis of reference.
items.inference: If heat is inseparable, appealing to the burning substrate as an example is problematic.
uncertainties: The implied apodosis of the conditional clause is not explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: If, given inseparability from heat, the example is taken from the substrate of burning.
